steps.observed: React app loaded successfully with nav links: Templates, Profile, Promotions

steps.action: Click 'Promotions' nav link to navigate to /promotion
steps.observed: URL changed to http://localhost:8080/start — redirect confirmed

steps.action: Check for profile-required banner on /start page
steps.expected: Alert banner with text about profile being required
steps.observed: Alert element found with strong text 'Profile required:' and message 'Please complete your profile to continue to the Promotion Email Generator.'

evidence.network: No network requests involved — redirect handled client-side by React Router

frictions.description: Hash-based navigation (window.location.hash = '#/promotion') did not trigger the redirect — the page stayed on the Templates view. Only clicking the 'Promotions' nav link (React Router Link component) properly triggered the redirect.
frictions.resolution: Used the 'Promotions' nav link (ref=e4) click instead of hash-based navigation to trigger the React Router redirect.

summary: Tested 1 assertion: VAL-PROMO-021 passed. When no profile is saved, navigating to /promotion redirects to /start and displays a yellow Alert banner with text 'Profile required: Please complete your profile to continue to the Promotion Email Generator.'
